_meta.source: yfinance tickers individually verified live (fast_info/longName AND >=100 rows of daily history over a 400-day window) against Yahoo Finance
_meta.note: Excluded 18 otherwise-valid NSE sectoral/thematic index tickers because Yahoo Finance only exposes a current quote for them (1 row of 'history' no matter the lookback window requested), not a real daily candle series - EMA/VWMA/any lookback indicator can never compute for them, so including them would just show null indicator values forever. Excluded: NIFTYFIN (NIFTY_FIN_SERVICE.NS), NIFTYSMALLCAP100 (^CNXSC), NIFTYAUTO (^CNXAUTO), NIFTYFMCG (^CNXFMCG), NIFTYMETAL (^CNXMETAL), NIFTYREALTY (^CNXREALTY), NIFTYENERGY (^CNXENERGY), NIFTYMEDIA (^CNXMEDIA), NIFTYPSE (^CNXPSE), NIFTYPSUBANK (^CNXPSUBANK), NIFTYPVTBANK (NIFTY_PVT_BANK.NS), NIFTYINFRA (^CNXINFRA), NIFTYSERVICES (^CNXSERVICE), NIFTYMNC (^CNXMNC), NIFTYHEALTHCARE (NIFTY_HEALTHCARE.NS), NIFTYOILGAS (NIFTY_OIL_AND_GAS.NS), NIFTYCONSRDURBL (NIFTY_CONSR_DURBL.NS), NIFTYINDIADIGITAL (NIFTY_IND_DIGITAL.NS). Re-check with scripts/refresh_instrument_lists.py-style verification if Yahoo ever backfills history for these.
